release_gates: Every required module has a source implementation, permission contract, tests and product integration.
All optional modules are either packaged and tested or explicitly marked unavailable without being silently removed.
The old Gradle launcher and newer Soong system apps are unified with one source of truth.
Exact RMX5566RU device tree, kernel, vendor blobs, HAL, VINTF, partitions and AVB inputs are verified.
MANA update package is signed, versioned independently and tested with rollback.
No update is labelled installable until it is tested on the exact target device.
